purpose: Backup/floor for the derived kernel<->Normal ABI compatibility check. A crossflash is allowed out-of-the-box iff the drive's SAT/controller_id and the candidate firmware's SAT belong to the same family here. The ABI check, when available, is primary; this table is the fallback when the ABI token cannot be read, and a cross-check otherwise.
match_key_notes: Match on the 16-bit SAT/controller_id (hex, e.g. 8A10), NOT the model name. Model strings are display-only and collapse distinct families: BDR-US03 = 8510/8511 (F3) AND 8590/8591 (F4); BDR-213T = 9200/9201 (F11) AND 9400/9401 (F13); BDR-BDS7 = 8D30/8D31 (F7) AND 8E20/8E21 (F8); BDR-US02 = 8410 (F3) AND 8490 (F4). SAT is read from the firmware plaintext banner 'Hardware Version : SAT xxxx' (parse_banner) on both the on-drive/backup image and the candidate image; the drive also reports it live.

gate.different_family: deny unless --allow-crossflash (force) -> user's risk, explicitly not on us
gate.downgrade_note: A same-SAT lower-revision write is governed separately by the 0xFE kernel generation marker, not by this table.
